title: Classic sensitivity and specificity (Ferguson 2019)
differences_from_source: Specificity: the source used SPM12's parametric two-sample t-test of the lesion network maps against control lesions; here it is a Freedman-Lane permutation GLM (5000 permutations, voxel max-statistic FWE primary, BH-FDR secondary) with a lesion-volume covariate.
Per-lesion maps are thresholded with the N-aware Bonferroni FWE rule instead of a fixed |T|.
Group statistics use the per-lesion mean Fisher z maps (AvgFz), which do not depend on the connectome's N.
Connectome QA chips (degree and PC1) are added.
description: Sensitivity (overlap of thresholded maps in the cases) and specificity (cases against control lesions), combined in a conjunction map.
